name: tiletactician-docs

scripts.memory:check: python3 -m unittest discover -s scripts/sot_wiki -p 'test_*.py' && python3 scripts/sot_wiki/wiki_lint.py docs/wiki && python3 scripts/sot_wiki/wiki_reindex.py --check docs/wiki && python3 scripts/sot_wiki/wiki_index.py --check docs/wiki/_sources.json docs/wiki && python3 scripts/sot_wiki/wiki_to_agent_sot.py --check docs/AGENT_SOT.md docs/wiki && python3 scripts/sot_wiki/audit_harness_memory.py --repo .
scripts.memory:generate: python3 scripts/sot_wiki/wiki_reindex.py --write docs/wiki && python3 scripts/sot_wiki/wiki_index.py --out docs/wiki/_sources.json docs/wiki && python3 scripts/sot_wiki/wiki_to_agent_sot.py --out docs/AGENT_SOT.md docs/wiki
scripts.prebuild: npm run test:links && npm run links:check
scripts.test:links: node --test scripts/check-internal-links.test.mjs scripts/docs-contracts.test.mjs scripts/next-config.test.mjs && node --experimental-strip-types --test scripts/page-context.test.mjs

description: TileTactician documentation — Scrabble and Crossplay board analysis: every legal play, ranked by score, in real time.
